fieldValues.title: Flags triaged by a person, kept rate counted
fieldValues.move: Show every flag to the maintainer as a triage step (keep, dismiss, escalate) before anything reaches the page, publish only kept flags, and count the kept rate per stage so the guidance is tightened where it is low.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Does not stop the process from flagging too much; it stops over-flagging reaching readers and measures it.
fieldValues.falsifier: After three meetings the kept rate stays below a third, or the secretary dismisses flags in bulk without reading them.
fieldValues.return_when: Two thirds or more of flags shown are kept for three meetings running: triage can then sample instead of reading all.
